name: xemgiadat-open-source
description: Vietnamese Real Estate Platform - 100% Open Source Edition

scripts.optimize: npm run optimize:js && npm run optimize:css
scripts.analyze: echo "File sizes:" && Get-ChildItem public\*.js, public\*.css, public\*.html -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, @{N='Size_KB';E={[Math]::Round($_.Length/1KB)}} || dir public\*.js public\*.css public\*.html
